nature_of_ownership: Ram Shriram TR UA 09/10/2021 2021 RS Irrevocable Trust
footnote_text: Reflects an annuity distribution on October 13, 2026, of 86,550 shares of Class A Common Stock and 86,550 shares of Class C Capital Stock from the 2021 RS Irrevocable Trust UAD 9/10/2021 (the '2021 GRAT') to the Reporting Person, who is the trustee and sole annuitant of the 2021 GRAT. This annuity payment constitutes a mere change in the form of beneficial ownership exempt from Section 16(a) and Section 16(b) pursuant to Rule 16a-13. Following the annuity payment, the remaining shares held by the 2021 GRAT were distributed to the beneficiary pursuant to the terms of the trust, which constitutes a disposition by bona fide gift exempt from Section 16(b) pursuant to Rule 16b-5.
